To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
organizational culture and market orientations have significant positive effect on performance of the microfinance institutions.
market orientation and organizational culture have a positive and significant influence on performance.
organizational culture is positively and significantly associated with performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the influence of organizational factors on the performance of microfinance organizations.
the influence of organizational factors on performance.
the relationship between organizational cultural, market orientation and performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
organizational culture and market orientations are important determinants of performance in microfinance institutions.
organizational culture and market orientations are positively associated with performance of microfinance in Kenya.
the influence of market orientation and organizational culture on performance is more pronounced in mature industries that are diverse in terms of customers’ needs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the study demonstrates that organizational culture and market oriented practices are important in the microfinance industry in Kenya.
the influence of market orientation and organizational culture on performance is not universal.
the relationship between market orientation and performance is more likely to be positive when there is high degree of organizational culture.

microfinance institutions need to spend more time in nurturing organizational culture and market oriented behavior to improve performance.
organizations need to nurture organizational culture and market-orientation as a means of creating sustainable competitive advantage.
organizations need to invest in nurturing a culture that is customer focused and market oriented in order to achieve superior performance.
